label: conj:q-gl-kummer-filtration
title: Kummer filtration on $q$-local systems
html:
Conjecture. Kummer filtration on q-local systems

The Kummer tower \mu_1 \subset \mu_2 \subset \cdots \subset \mu_\infty \subset \mathbb{G}_m (Kummer filtration) induces a descending filtration on the moduli of q-local systems. For each n \geq 1, we define the level-n sublocus:

  \mathrm{LocSys}_{\check{G}_q}^{(n)}(X)
  \subset
  \mathrm{LocSys}_{\check{G}_q}(X).

This sublocus consists of q-local systems \mathcal{L}_q whose q-monodromy \Omega_q(\varrho) (q-local system) is n-divisible in \mathrm{End}(\tau(\mathcal{L}_q)) for every contractible \varrho.

  1. \mathrm{LocSys}_{\check{G}_q}^{(1)}(X) = \mathrm{LocSys}_{\check{G}_q}(X) (all q-local systems).
  2. The q-GL equivalence \mathbb{L}_q (q-GL conjecture) restricts to each filtered piece: 
      \mathbb{L}_q^{(n)} \colon
  \mathcal{D}_q^{(n)}\text{-}\mathrm{mod}(\mathrm{Bun}_{G_q})
  \xrightarrow{ \sim }
  \mathrm{QCoh}(\mathrm{LocSys}_{\check{G}_q}^{(n)}(X)).
    Here, \mathcal{D}_q^{(n)} consists of q-\mathcal{D}-modules whose Hecke eigenvalues have n-divisible monodromy.
  3. The sublocus \mathrm{LocSys}_{\check{G}_q}^{(n)} admits lifts through the brane tower only when n \mid \chi(A) (obstruction calculation). At levels n \nmid \chi(A), the perpetual obstruction prevents full lifting.
  4. The q-GL equivalence \mathbb{L}_q is well-defined as a \mathbb{G}_m-family on \mathbb{G}_m^{\mathrm{nt}} = \mathbb{G}_m \setminus \mu_\infty.
